INSERT INTO planners_locations (planner_id, sido_code, gugun_code) VALUES

mapper.select: SELECT pl.sido_code AS sido_code, pl.gugun_code AS gugun_code, s.sido_name AS sido_name, g.gugun_name AS gugun_name FROM planners_locations pl JOIN sidos s ON pl.sido_code = s.sido_code LEFT JOIN guguns g ON pl.gugun_code = g.gugun_code WHERE pl.planner_id = #{plannerId}
